items.sentence: Its strings run from a bridge on the body to tuning machines mounted at the far end of the neck.
Metal frets set into the fingerboard divide string lengths, allowing players to select different pitches by pressing strings down.
Many versions have six strings, though instruments with fewer or more strings are also made.
Acoustic models commonly use a hollow resonant body, while electric versions may have a solid body and magnetic pickups.
A player can pluck individual strings or brush several together to produce separate notes or a chord.
Pressing a string against a fret shortens its vibrating length and raises the note's pitch.
Turning tuning machines changes string tension, allowing the instrument's open strings to be adjusted to desired pitches.
Players often use a small plectrum or their fingertips to set the strings vibrating.
It is frequently heard in small bands, where performers may share rhythmic and melodic parts.
In music lessons, beginners practice chord changes and simple melodies on this portable instrument.
Recording studios use its clean or processed tones across genres, from folk arrangements to rock productions.
At informal gatherings, its portability makes it practical for leading group singalongs without elaborate equipment.
It often supplies harmonic accompaniment by sounding chords beneath a singer or another melodic performer.
In many ensembles, it carries melodic lines, including solos that stand out above the accompanying rhythm section.
Its low-register versions can reinforce bass parts, contributing pulse and harmonic foundation to a group's sound.
Songwriters use it to sketch harmonic progressions and develop musical ideas before arranging a full composition.
